text:
jen.k: Scheduling dedicated rollout for Delta Health on slice-17. Target window: Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pinning model to v1.12.3-quant. Need final ack on rollback criteria and comms before shift.

deploybot: @jen.k triggered rollout. id rb-1712345678. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m ramp, health checks at each gate.

samir: Capacity reservation confirmed: slice-17 has 4x reserved GPUs.

maria.g: Confirmed. KMS rotation—checked with security, should not affect logs. @ellen can you validate logs ingestion?

ellen: Validated. Logs pipeline and KMS key alias mapping tested against v1.12.3 artifacts. No expired keys.

ops_lead: Suggested rollback triggers: error rate > 0.5% sustained >3m; p95 latency >700ms sustained >5m; API 5xx rate >2x baseline. Also flag customer-visible semantic score drop.

samir: Add quality threshold: daily eval suite (semantic similarity) drop >3 points triggers rollback.

maria.g: Dashboards? send link pls.

samir: Dashboards: https://console.redwood/dashboards/rollouts/delta-health. Watch batch_efficiency_savings and token_cost_per_request.

jen.k: Rollback playbook (brief):
1) Pause traffic shift in deploybot;
2) run revert: deploybot revert --customer delta-health --slice slice-17 --to v1.11.9;
3) restore config: disable new KV cache and restore batcher to previous tokens;
4) notify customer + open incident if escalated.

jen.k: Example revert command:
```
deploybot revert --customer delta-health --slice slice-17 --to v1.11.9 --reason "auto-trigger"
```

ellen: Note: when reverting also flip kv_cache=false and set max_batch_tokens=2048 to match v1.11.9 warmup.

ops_lead: Good. Add automated pre-shift config drift check; if detected, rollout should pause and ping #eng-oncall.

deploybot: Auto config validation enabled. Will pause on drift and create alert to #eng-oncall.

maria.g: Who's oncall for window?

samir: I'm primary Wed 01:30-05:00 UTC. @ellen backup.

jen.k: Customer release note blurb (to include in email):
"We'll be rolling v1.12.3-quant to your dedicated slice (slice-17). Expect improved latency on long-context requests and reduced cost from quantization. We'll monitor closely and may revert within 15-30m if regressions detected. Contact delta-health-ops@delta.co for urgent issues."

maria.g: Add short rollback ETA line — looks good.

samir: Pre-rollout checklist: perf run (10k reqs) ✅; canary artifacts baked ✅; alerts configured ✅; customer notified ✅.

ellen: Smoke tests on private egress rules: pass.

ops_lead: If rollback occurs, notify #eng-releases, #incidents, and email delta-health-ops@delta.co. Also page SRE after 2 failed revert attempts.

jen.k: Please ack below with :white_check_mark: to proceed. I'll start the shift and post updates during the ramp.

maria.g: :white_check_mark: 

samir: :white_check_mark: 

ellen: :white_check_mark: 

ops_lead: :white_check_mark: 

deploybot: Rollout scheduled to start at 1712345678. Will post status updates automatically.

jen.k: Thanks team — starting go window. Will call an immediate rollback if thresholds breach. :rocket:
